question: What sum will earn a simple interest of Rs. 960 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Rate of Interest** for 3 years = 16% × 3 = 48%.

Given, 48% of **Principal** = ₹960.

1% = 960 ÷ 48 = 20.

100% (Principal) = 20 × 100 = ₹2000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest** (SI) = ₹960

**Time** (T) = 3 years

**Rate** (R) = 16% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae34815a48e859cbfd759e8fb2711e396ff65b7ac3894c08989affd7d980c07.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 960 = (P × 16 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 960 = (P × 48) ÷ 100

⇒ 48 × P = 960 × 100

⇒ P = 96000 ÷ 48

⇒ P = ₹2000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Simple Interest

It is the interest calculated only on the **original principal** amount for every period. SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** after T years is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest. A = P + SI = P[1 + (RT/100)].

Relationship between SI and Rate

For a constant principal and time, **Simple Interest** is directly proportional to the **Rate of Interest**.
